description: AbstractUserRole is an abstract class in the OrangeHRM system defining core methods for user role management and authorization, including permission checks and entity access methods.

classes.name: AbstractUserRole
classes.description: Defines the base class for user roles in OrangeHRM, including permission checks, entity access, and role management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the user role with a role name and an AbstractUserRoleManager instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number of the authenticated user or null.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntities
methods.description: Deprecated method intended to retrieve accessible entities of a given type; currently throws method not implemented.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityProperties
methods.description: Deprecated method intended to retrieve accessible entity properties; currently throws method not implemented.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of accessible entities of a specified type, considering permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to retrieve IDs for a given entity type, filtered by permissions.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Returns an array of Employee objects associated with the role, defaulting to empty.

methods.name: getAccessibleProjects
methods.description: Deprecated placeholder method for retrieving accessible projects; returns an empty array.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancies
methods.description: Deprecated placeholder method for retrieving accessible vacancies; returns an empty array.

methods.name: areRequiredPermissionsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the given set of permissions is permitted based on the role's data group and action permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Returns an array of quick launch items accessible under the given permissions; default is empty.
